sentences: Revolving credit utilization is the most important driver of default risk, and risk rises with it, with a strong effect that becomes steep for applicants using most of their credit limit.
The number of past delinquencies is the second most important driver, and risk increases with it, rising most between no delinquencies and one delinquency.
The effect of utilization grows with the number of past delinquencies: it is much larger for applicants with two delinquencies than for those with none.
Income has a weak to moderate effect, and risk decreases as income rises.
Length of credit history has a weak to moderate effect, and risk decreases as the history gets longer.
The debt-to-income ratio has a weak effect, and risk increases with it.
The data do not settle whether number of dependents or months at the current address matter, and age hardly matters.
